summary: PLCnext / virtualized-PLC edition of iaiops — Phoenix Contact PLCnext Control and vPLC (虚拟化 PLC) reached over its built-in OPC-UA server (opc.tcp 4840) and Modbus-TCP process-data server, plus the cross-protocol brain (dataflow diagnosis, downtime root cause, PdM, OEE, alarm, baseline). A packaging edition — no new connector, no PLCnext-vendor SDK: it routes to the standard OPC-UA and Modbus tools already shipped. Use when the task mentions PLCnext / PLCnext Control / AXC F / vPLC / virtual PLC / 虚拟 PLC / Phoenix Contact controller over OPC-UA or Modbus. Read-first; this edition's tool surface is read-only.
